title: User login with valid credentials
description: Verify that a user can successfully log in with correct email and password and receives a valid JWT token.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/login with valid email and password
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains a JWT token

title: User login with invalid credentials
description: Verify that login fails with incorrect email or password and returns appropriate error.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/login with invalid email and/or password
Verify response status is 401 Unauthorized
Verify response contains error message indicating authentication failure

title: Access protected endpoint without JWT token
description: Verify that accessing any protected API endpoint without a JWT token returns authorization error.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/v1/project without 'Authorization' header
Verify response status is 403 Forbidden or 401 Unauthorized
Verify response contains error indicating missing or invalid token

title: Create new project with valid data
description: Ensure a user can create a new project with a unique name not exceeding 100 characters.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain JWT token
Send POST request to /api/v1/project with a unique project name under 100 characters
Verify response status is 201 Created
Verify project is returned with correct details

title: Reject project creation with duplicate name
description: Verify that creating a project with a name already used by the user is rejected with an error.

steps.description: Authenticate and create project with name 'TestProject'
Send POST request to /api/v1/project with the same project name 'TestProject'
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify error message indicates project name duplication

title: Retrieve user's projects list with pagination
description: Verify the system returns the authenticated user's projects list with correct pagination and filtering.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain JWT token
Send GET request to /api/v1/project/current-user?page=0&size=10
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response contains up to 10 projects with pagination metadata

title: Create workflow block with valid variables
description: Verify that a workflow block can be created successfully with valid variable definitions including multiplicity and types.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain JWT token
Send POST request to /api/v1/block/workflow with valid block data and variables
Verify response status is 201 Created
Verify returned workflow block contains correct variables and metadata

title: Reject creation of block with invalid variable types
description: Ensure the API returns 400 Bad Request when block variables contain invalid or undefined types.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/v1/block/action with block variables referencing invalid types
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request
Verify error message explains variable type validation error

title: List blocks by type with pagination and filtering
description: Verify GET requests for /block/{type}/page correctly paginate, filter by name, and return appropriate results.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain JWT token
Send GET request to /api/v1/block/workflow/page?page=0&size=5&name=Sample
Verify response includes blocks filtered by 'Sample' with pagination data

title: Create custom data type with fields and inheritance
description: Verify creation of a new data type including fields and validate inheritance from an existing type without conflicts.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/v1/type with valid new type data including inherited parent type and custom fields
Verify response status is 201 Created
Verify fields and inheritance are correctly set in the response

title: Reject type creation with conflicting field names
description: Ensure that type creation is rejected with a 406 Not Acceptable error if field names conflict with inherited types.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/v1/type with fields that conflict with inherited parent fields
Verify response status is 406 Not Acceptable
Verify error message indicates field name conflicts

title: Delete existing service
description: Verify that an authenticated user can delete a service by serviceId and the service is removed from the listing.

steps.description: Send DELETE request to /api/v1/service/{serviceId} with valid serviceId
Verify response status is 204 No Content
Attempt to GET the deleted service and expect 404 Not Found

title: Export service configuration JSON file
description: Verify that the service configuration can be exported and downloaded in JSON format.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/v1/service/file/{serviceId}
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify response Content-Type is application/json

title: Create workflow scenario with blocks and variables
description: Verify the creation of a valid workflow scenario including scenario blocks and associated variables.

steps.description: Send POST request to /api/v1/scenario with valid scenario block and variable definitions
Verify response status is 201 Created
Verify the scenario details include blocks and variable linkages

title: Get scenario variables for a scenario block
description: Retrieve variables associated with a given scenario block and validate consistency.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/v1/scenario/{scenarioBlockId}/variables with a valid scenarioBlockId
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify variables belong to the specified scenario block and data is consistent

title: Update exit variables of a workflow scenario
description: Verify that the exit variables of a workflow scenario can be updated and validated correctly.

steps.description: Send PUT request to /api/v1/scenario/{workflowId}/variables/exit with updated variables
Verify response status is 200 OK
Verify exit variables are updated in the system

title: Handle invalid pagination parameters
description: Verify APIs correctly handle invalid pagination parameters and respond with appropriate errors or defaults.

steps.description: Send GET request to /api/v1/project?page=-1&size=0
Verify response status is 400 Bad Request or defaults applied

title: JWT token expiration enforcement
description: Verify that expired JWT tokens are rejected when accessing protected endpoints.

steps.description: Use an expired JWT token to access a protected endpoint
Verify response status is 401 Unauthorized
Verify response indicates token expiration

title: Logout invalidates current JWT token
description: Verify that logging out successfully invalidates the JWT token and subsequent requests with that token fail.

steps.description: Authenticate and obtain JWT token
Send POST request to /api/v1/auth/logout with valid JWT token
Verify response status is 200 OK
Attempt to access a protected endpoint with the logged out token
Verify response status is 401 Unauthorized

title: Role-based access control enforcement
description: Verify that endpoints enforce role-based permissions and deny actions unauthorized for the user's role.

steps.description: Authenticate as a user lacking required role for a restricted action
Attempt to perform a restricted action (e.g., deleting a project)
Verify response status is 403 Forbidden
Verify error message indicates insufficient permissions
